description: List the run categories for a game (e.g. "Any%", "100%", "Glitchless"). Use the game ID from search_games. Each category has an ID needed to fetch a leaderboard via get_leaderboard. Example: get_categories({ game_id: "o1y9wo6q" })

_apiKey.description: Optional speedrun.com API key for authenticated access; omit to use the shared platform key

game_id.description: Speedrun.com game ID, as returned by search_games (e.g. "o1y9wo6q")

name: get_categories
title: Get Categories
